about: Each template's minimum frame in px at 1440 px and wider: the narrowest the site header, and the main part of the home, category and tag pages, may draw. layout.mjs fails a page below it. These are today's frames, measured on 2026-11-04 in Chromium and Firefox; each template's design brief in docs/templates/ sets the number that replaces it. "reading_pending" lists the templates whose post reading check is not enforced yet, because their redesign has not landed; each redesign removes its own name. Until then a template reads in system fonts, whose widths differ from machine to machine, so its line length is not stable enough to check.
